description: Sends an email using a predefined Salesforce email template with merge field support.

add_threading_tokens.description: Whether to add threading tokens for email-to-case or custom threading. Useful for case-related emails.
add_threading_tokens.human_parameter_description: Add special tokens to help keep replies tied to the right case or conversation thread. Use this when emailing about a case.
add_threading_tokens.title: Add Threading Tokens

additional_to_addresses.description: Additional email addresses to send to (besides the recipient). Can be a comma-delimited string or a list.
additional_to_addresses.human_parameter_description: Add extra primary recipients to the email in addition to the main recipient. Enter one address or multiple.
additional_to_addresses.title: Additional To Addresses

attachment_ids.description: IDs of files to attach. Can be a comma-delimited string or a list.
attachment_ids.human_parameter_description: Attach files by providing their file IDs. You can include one or multiple attachments.
attachment_ids.title: Attachment Ids

bcc_addresses.description: BCC email addresses. Can be a comma-delimited string or a list.
bcc_addresses.human_parameter_description: People you want to blind-copy on the email. Other recipients won’t see these addresses.
bcc_addresses.title: Bcc Addresses

cc_addresses.description: CC email addresses. Can be a comma-delimited string or a list.
cc_addresses.human_parameter_description: People you want to copy on the email. They’ll receive the message and can see other CC’d recipients.
cc_addresses.title: Cc Addresses

log_email.description: Whether to log the email on the recipient's activity timeline. Defaults to true for template emails.
log_email.human_parameter_description: Choose whether to save this email to the recipient’s activity history. Turn this off if you don’t want it recorded.
log_email.title: Log Email

recipient_id.description: ID of the lead, contact, or person account to send the email to. Required when using templates.
recipient_id.human_parameter_description: Select the person you’re emailing by providing their record ID. Use a Lead, Contact, or Person Account ID for the recipient.
recipient_id.title: Recipient Id

related_record_id.description: ID of a related record (e.g., Case, Opportunity) to populate merge fields from a different object.
related_record_id.human_parameter_description: Optionally link a related record (like a Case or Opportunity) so the template can pull in the right details. Use this if your template references another object.
related_record_id.title: Related Record Id

sender_address.description: Organization-wide email address. Required only when sender_type is OrgWideEmailAddress.
sender_address.human_parameter_description: If you selected an organization-wide sender, enter that email address here. Leave blank if using your own user.
sender_address.title: Sender Address

sender_type.description: Type of sender. Valid values: CurrentUser, DefaultWorkflowUser, OrgWideEmailAddress.
sender_type.human_parameter_description: Choose who the email should appear to be from—your user, the default workflow user, or an organization-wide email address.
sender_type.title: Sender Type

template_id.description: ID of the email template to use.
template_id.human_parameter_description: Choose the email template you want to send. This selects the content and merge fields used in the message.
template_id.title: Template Id

name: send_email_from_template

EmailSimpleError.description: Error object returned when emailSimple action fails.

fields.description: Array of field names that caused or are related to the error.
fields.title: Fields

message.description: Detailed error message describing what went wrong.
message.title: Message

EmailSimpleError.title: EmailSimpleError

SendEmailFromTemplateResponse.description: Response from Salesforce REST Actions API emailSimple invocable action.

actionName.description: Name of the action executed. For emailSimple, this returns 'emailSimple'.
actionName.title: Action Name

errors.description: Array of error objects when the action fails. Null when isSuccess is true.
errors.title: Errors

isSuccess.description: Indicates whether the action execution was successful.
isSuccess.title: Is Success

outputValues.description: Output data from the action containing email send confirmation details. Null when isSuccess is false.
outputValues.title: Output Values

SendEmailFromTemplateResponse.title: SendEmailFromTemplateResponse
